[[Luluh's Spear]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] dropped by [[Corporal Luluh]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Dejarin Estate]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Suntouched Spear]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Suntouched Spear]] from collector [[Nikun]] or crafters [[Hahbe]], [[Kol Swordshanks]], [[Asiri]] or [[Aksah]]
*[[Fiery]] [[Spearhead]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Spear Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*[[Suntouched Spear]] from collectors [[Poti]] or [[Kaya]] or crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Fiery]] [[Spearhead]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Spear Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
AND
*White [[dye]]
